unit.why: A single cited sentence from another book (ה"ה, פ' וירא), reporting that the messiah told R. Elimelech the redemption depends on returning the exiled ark. It is a saying inside a homiletic discussion of the ark, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: part of a running homiletic/citation chain on the ark and redemption that spans the previous and next divisions
